a.name: Coins in the hand
a.desc: A small handful of coins clinking together in your palm.
a.note: Kenney RPG handleCoins2: its loudest clink cluster (176 ms) first, its earlier cluster overlapped 40 ms later for a dense handful, then scattered clinks from handleCoins (0.42 s on) as the coins settle.

b.name: Coins spill out
b.desc: A shower of coins pours out and lands with one last bright clink.
b.note: Freesound light coin shower: a dense spill burst (0.885 s) then a second, quieter double burst (6.64 s); one ringing coin drop from 'coin drop into coins' lands last.

c.name: Heavy coin purse
c.desc: A fat leather purse thumps down and the heavy coins inside clink.
c.note: A coin drop from 'coin drop into coins' pitched 4 semitones down (heavy gold) leads so the start is clean and instant; Kenney dropLeather's thump lands 6 ms later under it, and a second low coin settles at 140 ms. Darker than A and B.

a.name: Harp rushing up
a.desc: A quick harp sweep rising up, with a sprinkle of chimes on top.
a.note: Freesound 'HARP GLISSANDO UP', the fast sweep at 21.3 s (peaks ~190 ms in), with its natural ring; the kit 'Chimes' shimmer enters at the top of the sweep, quieter.

b.name: Celesta bell steps
b.desc: Four little bell notes step upward and ring out like a music box.
b.note: Freesound 'Celesta Chime': a four-note rising arpeggio (first 250 ms) and its long ring, raised 3 semitones to sit brighter; no extra layer so the steps stay clear.

c.name: Bell swell and toll
c.desc: A ringing swell rushes in and lands on a clear, solemn bell.
c.note: Last 355 ms of the reversed bell swells into a Kenney heavy bell an octave up (tolling, ~720 Hz) with a natural ding for the bright partials; loudest at the strike, ~355 ms.

a.name: Iron chest and glow
a.desc: A heavy iron chest clanks open and a soft magic glow rings out.
a.note: Freesound metal chest foley: two iron clanks and the ringing hinge (2.27-2.99 s, a quiet take, so +12 dB); the kit 'Glimmer' chime blooms behind it at 250 ms, well under the clank.

b.name: Creaking lid, sparkle
b.desc: An old wooden lid creaks open and a bright sparkle rings out.
b.note: Freesound 'chest openning crack': the ratcheting hinge creak from 200 ms (peak at ~314 ms into the cut), then the kit 'Sparkle' bell tone enters under its end.

c.name: Latches and a bell
c.desc: Two brass latches snap open, then a small bell rings.
c.note: Freesound antique trunk: two latch snaps 210 ms apart (3.43 s in the file), then the kit 'Small Bell' at 250 ms as the reward ring.

layers.credit: "Opening Antique Trunk - More Latches.wav" by rodincoil, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/rodincoil/sounds/271377

a.name: Heavy door opens
a.desc: A great wooden door unbolts with a thud and groans slowly open.
a.note: Freesound 'big wooden door': the heavy unlatch thud (2.25 s), then a low door groan from 'squeaky door' (3.15-4.6 s) pitched down for size, kept well under the thud.

b.name: War horn call
b.desc: A deep war horn sounds, with a drum beat under it.
b.note: Kit war horn blast (peaks at its start, long call) cut to 1.9 s with a slow fade; a dark timpani hit under the onset for a determined first beat.

c.name: Great gong bloom
c.desc: A huge low gong is struck and swells around you.
c.note: Freesound 32-inch Paiste gong: soft strike that blooms to its loudest ~320 ms in and holds; cut to 1.9 s with a long fade.
